# NIPAT 0.8.9 — release evidence and scope

This record separates scientific equivalence, automated package qualification
and observations on an installed Windows system. It is not a domain-validation
certificate or a claim that all desktop installation scenarios have been tested.

## Source identities

- Frozen scientific reference: `eafadf7002a9c7d7c1b9af9ccafc47d698a059e5`
  (`v0.8.5`), retained under `tests/reference_r/0.8.5`.
- Windows-tested R candidate: `14e6794efe9f2d9dd174d51947576d941687e86d`.
- Final packaging source: `258e4d31d9260157e09df2cee2feda3a502bb973`.

The final packaging source has identical bytes to the Windows-tested candidate
under `scientific`, `src`, `engine`, `installer`, `docker` and `config`, and in
`pyproject.toml`. Its changes update documentation, the packaged documentation
inventory and release acceptance procedures. A fresh installer build supplies
the final package identities; previous package hashes are not reused.

## Scientific and automated evidence

The [original candidate CI](https://github.com/GregorioDalia/nipat-desktop/actions/runs/42379749437)
and [candidate installer build](https://github.com/GregorioDalia/nipat-desktop/actions/runs/42380627013)
retain 13 full-script differential cases across all four scientific workflows.
Their reports record exact table bytes, identical unrounded R objects and exact
rendered PDF pixels. The retained artifacts contain 37 tables and 48 PDF
comparisons, rendered at 36 DPI for this synthetic suite, plus 157 focused R
comparisons (DNP 52, SNP 33, CPI 72). The reference and candidate run in the same
scientific image for each comparison. Microbenchmarks describe isolated
operations; they do not establish end-to-end speedups or peak-memory reductions.

The [final installer build](https://github.com/GregorioDalia/nipat-desktop/actions/runs/42388774190)
and [final-source PR CI](https://github.com/GregorioDalia/nipat-desktop/actions/runs/42388659743)
are the qualification sources for publication. Schema 6 requires the retained
final-build report, its exact SHA-256, the frozen reference bytes, the candidate
R bytes, the packaged image and the complete installer set to agree. It rejects
older acceptance schemas for 0.8.9 and incomplete per-case PDF evidence.

The publication workflow rechecks actual installer bytes, their common
scientific archive and the acceptance record before preparing and publishing
the same immutable package set. `scientific-equivalence-check.json` records the
additional scientific verification. Only synthetic qualification artifacts are
included in public release assets.

## Historical Windows observation

An installed 0.8.5 client on Windows 11 with WSL completed runtime diagnostics
and a DNP analysis on 5 November 2026. Its recorded source was the frozen
`eafadf7` commit, with a clean source identity, and its installer manifest hash
was `ae71a966008e5099e39297ceac60d446512b5a67ed87b01b6ae92c43fb3d8d5e`.
The retained private run metadata and output contract support the observations
`installation_ready`, `runtime_diagnostics` and `dnp_sample_analysis`.
Here, readiness means an operational installed client; the setup process itself
was not observed by this review. No self-test or automatic-workflow observation
is inferred from this run.

A separate Windows 11/WSL execution of the 0.8.9 candidate identifies `14e6794`
and the corresponding installer manifest. Its recorded engine source hashes
match that candidate. This is an observation of the earlier candidate, not a
claim that the final rebuilt installer was installed on that machine. Real
sample identifiers, paths, inputs, tables, plots and run archives are excluded
from the repository and public release evidence.

## Qualification limits

- The automatic Linux upgrade check exercises 0.7.2 to 0.8.9; it must not be
  described as a direct 0.8.5 to 0.8.9 installation test.
- Both native macOS package/client checks are automatic. Dedicated runtime
  qualification with Lima/Rosetta on both architectures has not been performed.
- The six desktop acceptance scenarios remain explicitly deferred in the
  research acceptance record. Partial observations do not convert them to passes.
- Scientific equivalence is limited to the executed cases. Independent domain
  validation remains pending.

The published 0.8.9 is the official stable-channel package. Subsequent 0.8.10
development candidates are identified by commit and build and do not change
the stable release or its update manifests.
